title: Foundation, Rule & Law — Generative Zero-Points of the House
purpose: Model the events, rules, instruments, texts, institutions and practices that create a durable center from which a system can reproduce, branch, remember itself and evolve through time.
project_clue: In Potato geometry a Foundation can simultaneously act as Seed, Center and Plane/Platform. It is a 'dead point' only in the sense of a fixed historical reference coordinate: a preserved F0 state from which living development can be traced. The Archive/Akashic layer preserves successive states; the Spiral tracks return-with-change; the Tree tracks branching from the founded center.
core_definition: A Foundation is a sufficiently stable generative commitment or state that later actors can point back to in order to answer: what is this, why does it exist, what rules bind it, who belongs, what may be changed, and what counts as continuity?

F0_dead_point.meaning: Earliest fixed/recoverable reference state of the founded thing.
F0_dead_point.boundary: Not literal death and not always a single instant; ancient traditions may have an F0 interval or contested cluster.

seed.meaning: Compressed generative content: founding idea, covenant, charter, revelation, rule, method, design or initiative.

center.meaning: Reference point later branches return to when arguing identity, legitimacy, reform or fidelity.

plane_platform.meaning: The newly constituted surface of possibility on which later practices, institutions, laws, schools or branches can operate.

archive_point.meaning: The foundation becomes a temporal coordinate in the record; later versions can be compared against it instead of silently overwriting it.

spiral_origin.meaning: A system can return to the same founding principle under changed conditions. Each return may reinterpret rather than duplicate F0.

tree_origin.meaning: Once the platform is viable, branches differentiate: denominations, agencies, schools, amendments, products, jurisdictions, subsidiaries, interpretations or reforms.

non_equivalences.root: Provenance/dependency/ancestry that may predate foundation and remain causally active.
non_equivalences.seed: Transferable generative potential; seed becomes foundation only when it establishes a durable reference/platform.
non_equivalences.foundation: Stable generative center/platform to which later continuity can be referred.
non_equivalences.origin: Any earlier causal beginning; not every origin is durable enough to be a foundation.
non_equivalences.constitution: High-order foundation allocating authority, limits and amendment.
non_equivalences.law: Authoritative rule in a jurisdiction; only some laws are constitutive.
non_equivalences.rule: Local or system-wide instruction/norm; many rules can change without re-founding the whole.
non_equivalences.treaty: Agreement binding parties; may itself constitute an institution/order.
non_equivalences.covenant: Relationship-creating commitment that can combine identity, duties and sacred/legal memory.
non_equivalences.creed_confession: Doctrinal identity compression used for profession, teaching and boundary-making.
non_equivalences.canon: Authorized or inherited body of texts/rules that constrains interpretation.
non_equivalences.discipline_rule: Practice architecture governing how members live or work.
non_equivalences.manifesto: Self-conscious public declaration that may crystallize a movement without legal incorporation.
non_equivalences.standard_protocol: Technical/social rule-set whose foundation value comes from shared interoperability.
non_equivalences.precedent_custom: Repeated inherited practice that becomes load-bearing without one founding text.

multiple_clocks.meaning: Predecessor conditions or inherited field already exist.
Competent authority grants permission, charter or recognition.
Constitutive instrument is adopted, signed, promulgated or declared.
Canon, governance, resources or practice become durably recognizable.
Later reform changes the platform while preserving or redefining continuity.
Distinct descendant schools, agencies, denominations, subsidiaries or interpretations become stable.
Foundation expires, is replaced or becomes archival rather than operative.

date_contract.rule: Never collapse authorization, legal effect, first operation and later consolidation into one start date when the distinction matters.

structural_significance_indicators.rule: These are descriptive flags, not an overall political/religious ranking.
indicators: interpretive — repeatedly used to resolve disputes about meaning
path_dependent — later choices remain constrained by this founding state
currently_referenced — still invoked in current rules/identity
refoundable — contains or later acquires amendment/revision machinery

foundation_questions: What problem, promise or revelation concentrated into the Seed?
What turned the Seed into a stable platform rather than a passing event?
Who or what had authority to constitute it?
What is the earliest recoverable source state?
When did it actually begin operating?
Which later reforms are ordinary development and which are refoundations?
What old rule remains causally active even after formal replacement?
Who interprets the foundation when actors disagree?
What material platform lets the foundation reproduce itself?
What would have to change before we would say this is no longer the same system?

triune_projection.spirit: Purpose, telos, covenant, creed, values, legitimacy and identity story.
triune_projection.mind: Rules, doctrine, interpretation, governance, pedagogy, procedure, record and memory.
triune_projection.body: People, territory, membership, offices, buildings, capital, ritual, infrastructure and enforcement/operational capacity.

operator_relations.Root: substrate and active inherited cause before/below F0
operator_relations.Seed: compressed idea/covenant/design that may become Foundation
operator_relations.Plane: the operating surface made possible by the foundation
operator_relations.Center: reference coordinate for identity and return
operator_relations.Spiral: return to founding principles under changed conditions
operator_relations.Archive_Akashic: preserved sequence F0→F1→F2 rather than one overwritten present
operator_relations.Pillar: recurring principle bearing load across later cases
operator_relations.House: the differentiated living system built on the foundation
operator_relations.Fruit: consequences produced by the founded order
operator_relations.Ash: superseded rule that remains historically/path-dependently relevant

importance_rule: In principle almost anything can be foundational at some scale. Public prominence should depend on structural reach: does it constitute identity, generate descendants, remain a reference in disputes, reproduce practice, create a platform, or constrain later possibilities? A minor local rule can still be foundational inside a small context.
